meta.exits: limit 0.1% under close, stop 4xATR(14), one exit at 2R, 96h

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.rule: after a 5-bar drop; lower wick >= 2x body; upper wick <= 10% of range; body >= 5% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

inverted_hammer.name: Inverted hammer
inverted_hammer.rule: after a 5-bar drop; upper wick >= 2x body; lower wick <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

dragonfly_doji.name: Dragonfly doji
dragonfly_doji.rule: after a 5-bar drop; body <= 5% of range; upper wick <= 10%; range >= 0.5 ATR

gravestone_doji.name: Gravestone doji
gravestone_doji.rule: after a 5-bar rise; body <= 5% of range; lower wick <= 10%; range >= 0.5 ATR

doji_after_drop.name: Doji after a drop
doji_after_drop.rule: after a 5-bar drop; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

doji_after_rise.name: Doji after a rise
doji_after_rise.rule: after a 5-bar rise; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

long_legged_doji.name: Long-legged doji
long_legged_doji.rule: body <= 10% of range, both wicks >= 35%, range >= 1 ATR

spinning_top.name: Spinning top
spinning_top.rule: body 10-30% of range, both wicks >= the body

bull_marubozu.name: Bullish marubozu
bull_marubozu.rule: green, body >= 90% of range, range >= 1 ATR

bear_marubozu.name: Bearish marubozu
bear_marubozu.rule: red, body >= 90% of range, range >= 1 ATR

bull_belt_hold.name: Bullish belt hold
bull_belt_hold.rule: after a 5-bar drop; green, opens at the low (<= 5% of range), body >= 60%, range >= 1 ATR

big_bull_bar.name: Big green candle (momentum ignition)
big_bull_bar.rule: green, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

big_bear_bar.name: Big red candle (capitulation bar)
big_bear_bar.rule: red, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

bull_engulfing.name: Bullish engulfing
bull_engulfing.rule: after a 5-bar drop; red then green whose body covers the red body

bear_engulfing.name: Bearish engulfing
bear_engulfing.rule: after a 5-bar rise; green then red whose body covers the green body

bull_harami.name: Bullish harami
bull_harami.rule: after a drop; big red (body >= 0.75 ATR, >= 60% of range) then a green body inside it, <= half its size

bear_harami.name: Bearish harami
bear_harami.rule: after a rise; big green then a red body inside it, <= half its size

bull_harami_cross.name: Bullish harami cross
bull_harami_cross.rule: bullish harami whose second candle is a doji

piercing_line.name: Piercing line
piercing_line.rule: after a drop; big red, then green opening at/below its close and closing above its midpoint (not above its open)

dark_cloud_cover.name: Dark cloud cover
dark_cloud_cover.rule: after a rise; big green, then red opening at/above its close and closing below its midpoint

tweezer_bottom.name: Tweezer bottom
tweezer_bottom.rule: after a drop; red then green with lows within 0.05 ATR

tweezer_top.name: Tweezer top
tweezer_top.rule: after a rise; green then red with highs within 0.05 ATR

bull_kicker.name: Bullish kicker
bull_kicker.rule: strong red, then strong green opening above the red's open (a gap; rare in 24/7 crypto)

outside_bar_up.name: Outside bar, up close
outside_bar_up.rule: range covers the prior bar and closes above the prior high

outside_bar_down.name: Outside bar, down close
outside_bar_down.rule: range covers the prior bar and closes below the prior low

inside_bar.name: Inside bar
inside_bar.rule: high below and low above the prior bar's

inside_bar_break_up.name: Inside bar breakout up
inside_bar_break_up.rule: an inside bar, then a close above the mother bar's high

inside_bar_break_down.name: Inside bar breakdown
inside_bar_break_down.rule: an inside bar, then a close below the mother bar's low

nr7_break_up.name: NR7 breakout up
nr7_break_up.rule: prior bar has the narrowest range of 7, then a close above its high

morning_star.name: Morning star
morning_star.rule: after a drop; big red, small body (<= 30% of it), green closing above the red's midpoint

evening_star.name: Evening star
evening_star.rule: after a rise; big green, small body, red closing below the green's midpoint

morning_doji_star.name: Morning doji star
morning_doji_star.rule: morning star whose middle candle is a doji

evening_doji_star.name: Evening doji star
evening_doji_star.rule: evening star whose middle candle is a doji

three_white_soldiers.name: Three white soldiers
three_white_soldiers.rule: 3 green, higher closes, each opening inside the prior body, bodies >= 60% of range and >= 0.5 ATR, small upper wicks

three_black_crows.name: Three black crows
three_black_crows.rule: 3 red, lower closes, each opening inside the prior body, bodies >= 60% of range and >= 0.5 ATR

three_inside_up.name: Three inside up
three_inside_up.rule: bullish harami, then a close above the first candle's open

three_inside_down.name: Three inside down
three_inside_down.rule: bearish harami, then a close below the first candle's open

three_outside_up.name: Three outside up
three_outside_up.rule: bullish engulfing, then a higher close

three_outside_down.name: Three outside down
three_outside_down.rule: bearish engulfing, then a lower close

bull_three_line_strike.name: Bullish three-line strike
bull_three_line_strike.rule: three black crows, then one green candle opening at/below the last close and closing above the first open

bear_three_line_strike.name: Bearish three-line strike
bear_three_line_strike.rule: three white soldiers, then one red candle closing below the first open

rising_three.name: Rising three methods
rising_three.rule: big green, 3 small candles inside its range, then a green close above it

falling_three.name: Falling three methods
falling_three.rule: big red, 3 small candles inside its range, then a red close below it

double_bottom.name: Double bottom (neckline break)
double_bottom.rule: two swing lows 10-80 bars apart within 0.5 ATR, neckline >= 1.5 ATR above; close breaks the neckline within 30 bars

double_top.name: Double top (neckline break)
double_top.rule: two swing highs within 0.5 ATR; close breaks below the neckline

inverse_hs.name: Inverse head and shoulders
inverse_hs.rule: 3 swing lows, middle >= 1 ATR lowest, shoulders within 1 ATR; close breaks the neckline

hs_top.name: Head and shoulders top
hs_top.rule: 3 swing highs, middle >= 1 ATR highest, shoulders within 1 ATR; close breaks below the neckline

bos_up.name: Break of structure up (trend continuation)
bos_up.rule: higher highs and higher lows, then a close above the last swing high

choch_up.name: Change of character up (CHoCH)
choch_up.rule: lower highs and lower lows, then a close above the last swing high

choch_down.name: Change of character down
choch_down.rule: higher highs and higher lows, then a close below the last swing low

asc_triangle.name: Ascending triangle breakout
asc_triangle.rule: two swing highs within 0.3 ATR, rising swing lows; close above the flat top

desc_triangle.name: Descending triangle breakdown
desc_triangle.rule: two swing lows within 0.3 ATR, falling swing highs; close below the flat bottom

sym_triangle_up.name: Symmetrical triangle breakout up
sym_triangle_up.rule: falling swing highs and rising swing lows; close above the upper trendline

falling_wedge.name: Falling wedge breakout
falling_wedge.rule: highs and lows both falling, highs faster; close above the upper trendline

rising_wedge.name: Rising wedge breakdown
rising_wedge.rule: highs and lows both rising, lows faster; close below the lower trendline

bull_flag.name: Bull flag breakout
bull_flag.rule: a >= 3 ATR rise in <= 8 bars, a 4-15 bar pause holding the top half, then a close above the pause

bear_flag.name: Bear flag breakdown
bear_flag.rule: a >= 3 ATR drop in <= 8 bars, a 4-15 bar pause, then a close below it

fvg_retest.name: Fair value gap retest (bullish FVG)
fvg_retest.rule: 3-bar gap (low > high 2 bars back, >= 0.1 ATR); first return into it within 30 bars that closes above its bottom

ob_retest.name: Order block retest (bullish)
ob_retest.rule: last red candle before a close above the 20-bar high; first return into it within 40 bars that closes above its low

pdl_sweep.name: Prior-day low sweep and reclaim
pdl_sweep.rule: trades below yesterday's low (UTC) and closes back above it, first time that day

pdh_break.name: Prior-day high breakout
pdh_break.rule: first close above yesterday's high that day

pdh_reject.name: Prior-day high sweep and rejection
pdh_reject.rule: trades above yesterday's high and closes back below it

fib_618.name: Fibonacci 61.8% retracement bounce
fib_618.rule: after a >= 4 ATR swing up (40 bars), the first touch of the 61.8% retracement that closes above it

pivot_s1.name: Floor pivot S1 bounce
pivot_s1.rule: touches today's S1 (from yesterday's H/L/C) and closes above it, first time that day

pivot_r1_reject.name: Floor pivot R1 rejection
pivot_r1_reject.rule: trades above R1 and closes back below it

rsi_bull_div.name: RSI bullish divergence
rsi_bull_div.rule: close below the lowest close of bars 5-20 back while RSI(14) is >= 3 higher than at that low (which was < 35)

rsi_bear_div.name: RSI bearish divergence
rsi_bear_div.rule: close above the highest close of bars 5-20 back while RSI(14) is >= 3 lower than at that high (which was > 65)

rsi2_connors.name: RSI(2) below 10 above the 200 SMA (Connors)
rsi2_connors.rule: RSI(2) crosses below 10 while close > SMA(200)

macd_up.name: MACD crosses above signal
macd_up.rule: MACD(12,26,9) line crosses above its signal line

macd_up_below0.name: MACD bullish cross below zero
macd_up_below0.rule: MACD crosses above signal while both are below zero

macd_down.name: MACD crosses below signal
macd_down.rule: MACD line crosses below its signal line

macd_hist_turn.name: MACD histogram turns up
macd_hist_turn.rule: histogram below 0 and rising after falling

bb_below.name: Close below the lower Bollinger band
bb_below.rule: close crosses below BB(20,2) lower band

bb_reentry.name: Back inside the Bollinger band from below
bb_reentry.rule: close back above the lower band after closing below it

bb_above.name: Close above the upper Bollinger band
bb_above.rule: close crosses above BB(20,2) upper band (breakout reading)

bb_squeeze_up.name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
bb_squeeze_up.rule: band width within 10% of its 120-bar low, then a close above the upper band

ttm_squeeze.name: TTM squeeze fires up
ttm_squeeze.rule: Bollinger bands were inside the Keltner channel and come out, close above EMA(20)

stochrsi_up.name: Stochastic RSI bullish cross below 0.2
stochrsi_up.rule: StochRSI(14) K crosses above D below 0.2

holy_grail.name: ADX Holy Grail pullback (Raschke)
holy_grail.rule: ADX > 30, +DI > -DI, low touches EMA(20) and closes above it

ichi_tk_up.name: Ichimoku TK cross above the cloud
ichi_tk_up.rule: Tenkan(9) crosses above Kijun(26) with close above the cloud

ichi_cloud_up.name: Ichimoku cloud breakout
ichi_cloud_up.rule: close crosses above the cloud (spans shifted 26)

aroon_up.name: Aroon bullish cross
aroon_up.rule: Aroon up(25) crosses above Aroon down while >= 70

obv_lead.name: OBV new high before price
obv_lead.rule: OBV at a 20-bar high while the close is not

obv_confirm.name: Breakout confirmed by OBV
obv_confirm.rule: close and OBV both at new 20-bar highs

vol_spike_bull.name: Volume spike on a green candle
vol_spike_bull.rule: volume >= 3x its 20-bar average, green body >= 50% of range

vol_spike_bear.name: Volume spike on a red candle
vol_spike_bear.rule: volume >= 3x average, red body >= 50% of range

vwap_reclaim.name: Reclaim of the 24h VWAP
vwap_reclaim.rule: close crosses above the rolling 24h VWAP

vwap_lose.name: Loss of the 24h VWAP
vwap_lose.rule: close crosses below the rolling 24h VWAP

ha_green.name: Heikin-Ashi turns green
ha_green.rule: first green Heikin-Ashi candle after 3 red

ha_red.name: Heikin-Ashi turns red
ha_red.rule: first red Heikin-Ashi candle after 3 green

rally_24h.name: Big 24h rally (momentum)
rally_24h.rule: 24h return crosses above 2.5x its average absolute 24h move (30 days)

drop_24h.name: Big 24h drop (dip)
drop_24h.rule: 24h return crosses below -2.5x its average absolute 24h move

five_green.name: Five green candles in a row

five_red.name: Five red candles in a row
